description: Change one website issue (an action plan; cloud only) the way a person does in the dashboard: its status (open, in_progress, resolved, dismissed for a close as not planned that stays closed, wontfix), its assignee (the user id of a member of the organization; null clears it), its severity, and its title, body_md (the Markdown plan), type (bug, task or feature) and labels (replaces the list). Needs the audits:write scope and an owner, admin or editor role, like the dashboard. Set only the fields to change; at least one is required. A status change moves the issue's findings with it exactly as in the dashboard (a completed close releases them, a reopen re-links them), and a closed issue stays closed when a later audit runs: triage does not reopen what a person closed as not planned. A severity edit on a triage issue locks its priority against the next triage run. Each title, body_md, type or labels edit writes an agent-attributed entry on the issue's comment thread (with the earlier value) and locks that field against the next triage run. A field already locked (a person set it, or an earlier edit did; see `locked_fields` in get_issue) is refused with the typed error FIELD_LOCKED and nothing is written: ask the user to change it in the dashboard. To change the status of several issues at once pass issue_numbers instead of issue_number (status, assigned_to and severity only): closing more than one (resolved, dismissed or wontfix) answers status "confirmation_required" with the issues it would close and writes nothing until it is sent again with confirm: true. Closing a real problem as not planned hides it from the tracker: only do it when the user said so. The result is the issue as it reads afterwards.

assigned_to.description: User id of an organization member to assign to; null clears the assignee.

body_md.description: New Markdown plan. Refused (FIELD_LOCKED) when the body is locked.

confirm.description: Approve a bulk close of more than one issue (see issue_numbers).

issue_number.description: Issue number from list_issues. Give this or issue_numbers.

issue_numbers.description: Several issue numbers for a bulk status, assignee or severity change (no content edits). Closing more than one needs confirm: true.

labels.description: The issue's full label list (replaces it). Refused when labels are locked.

severity.description: New severity (a triage issue's priority follows and is locked).

title.description: New title. Refused (FIELD_LOCKED) when the title is locked.

type.description: New type. Refused (FIELD_LOCKED) when the type is locked.

website_id.description: Website id the issue belongs to.

name: update_issue
title: Update an issue
